records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Bright Systems!
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to the welcome email [email:584aa91b]; no tickets, so no signal of engagement at all. Silent accounts with no first project rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days, though Pro plan purchase implies some intent.

draft.subject: Getting Bright Systems started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Following up on my welcome note from last week. I know a new tool can be easy to put off in a busy week, so I'd like to make the first step small.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
